# lc-base-template

> Starter template for building accessible, interactive language-course exercise
> engines with React, TypeScript and Vite. Each engine is a self-contained,
> keyboard-operable, WCAG-conscious component driven by validated JSON content.

## Pages

A build emits a static course: a landing page plus one page per Learning Object.

- [Home](index.html): the course landing page — hero copy plus one card per
  Learning Object, linking to that LO's page. The template's example lesson has a
  card only while it is the only LO; a course with lessons of its own leaves it out,
  though `example.html` is still built.
- `<slug>.html`: one page per LO folder in `lo-config/`, named after the folder
  with its `lo-NN-` ordinal dropped (`lo-00-example` → `example.html`), beside
  this file. Each
  page's body is prerendered, so it reads and navigates without JavaScript, and
  hydrates into the interactive app when JavaScript runs.

Four debug pages exist and are **not part of a deployed course**. The exercise
showcase (`exercise-showcase.html`) is a gallery of every engine driven by
fixtures; the UI showcase (`ui-showcase.html`) renders every block type, as a
plain block and as a card, through the course page's own renderers; the debug sandbox (`debug-sandbox.html`) is a theme-token, typography
and icon reference for the designer that also renders `DESIGNER.md`,
`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `STRUCTURE.md` and `AGENTS.md` as HTML; and the code style page
(`code-style.html`) renders `docs/STYLE.md`, how the code is written, with its
examples. All four are
**opt-in per build** behind one fail-closed flag (`DEBUG=1 bun run build`,
or the older name `SHOWCASE=1`), so a deployed course contains none of them unless
that flag was set. They are listed here so their absence is not mistaken for a
broken link; do not treat any of them as a page of the course.

## Content blocks

An LO page is built from blocks declared in its JSON. Block types: `intro`,
`prose`, `grammar`, `vocabulary`, `outcomes`, `tabs` and `sources`. A `tabs` block is a
WAI-ARIA tab set (arrow keys, Home/End); below 48rem of block width the tab row is
hidden and a select dropdown (a combobox, named like the tablist) chooses the panel
instead. Its panels hold rich text and optional media (an image, an audio player and a
transcript in a native `<details>` toggle); every
panel is in the prerendered HTML, inactive ones carry `hidden`. A `sources` block is a
references list: citations in `<ul>` groups, each with a print or web icon whose
meaning is also given as screen-reader text.

## Engines

Fifteen engines ship. Each lives under `src/exercises/<engine>/` as pure logic
plus a thin React view, and is registered in `src/exercises/lazy-registry.ts`.
Most have their own pure grader; dictation and typed-transform share one in
`src/exercises/text-entry/`, and flashcards has a spaced-repetition scheduler
instead.

- Choice: select, inline-choice, radio-quiz
- Typing: inline-gap, typed-transform, dictation
- Matching: line-match, memory-match, word-spot
- Ordering: word-order, phrase-reorder, drag-fill-gaps
- Study and reading: flashcards, reading, conjugation

## Notes

- UI chrome strings resolve through `src/config/ui-strings.ts` (English by default);
  authored content carries the target language via `lang` attributes.
- Design tokens and theme colours live in `src/styles/`.
- This file describes the **built site**. Repository-level house rules for AI
  agents editing the source live in `AGENTS.md`, which is not shipped.
